div.head: List of persons
div.p: Editor’s Note:—The identification of the persons in this list is generally limited to circumstances and positions under reference in this volume. Historical personages alluded to in the volume, officials noted in documents but not actively participating in substantive discussions, and individuals only mentioned in passing are not identified here. All titles and positions are American unless there is an indication to the contrary. An asterisk *) indicates participation in the Sixth Session of the Council of Foreign Ministers, Paris, May 23–June 20. A dagger (†) indicates participation in the meetings of the Deputies for Austria of the Council of Foreign Ministers. A double dagger (‡) indicates participation in the Washington talks on Germany, April 6–8.
